narr: Deep monsoon moisture remained over northern Arizona with thunderstorms, heavy rain, and flash flooding.
ev: Six feet of water was flowing through Burnt Corn Wash.
Heavy rain caused flash flooding in Antelope Canyon. The popular tourist slot canyon was closed for at least a day so that the water could be removed and sand could be replaced.

Heavy rain over the Pipeline/Tunnel (2022) and Schultz Fire (2010) scars caused extensive flash flooding northwest through northeast of Flagstaff. Highway 89 northeast of Flagstaff was closed in both directions around mile post 425 around 442 PM MST. The following roads in far northeast Flagstaff were flooded: Copeland Lane, Gunman Road, Vista de Oro, Pioneer Valley Road, and Neptune Drive. Highway 180 northwest of Flagstaff was closed in both directions around MP 218 at 419 PM. The Stevanna Way and Coconino Estates neighborhoods on the northwest side of Flagstaff flooded with apartments, homes, and streets impacted.
A video of flash flooding three miles north of Fort Defiance was posted on social media.
